title: Pune logistics SaaS plugged an 18% pilot-to-paid leak with a CFO-ready ROI trail
content: SITUATION: A Pune logistics SaaS (route optimization + ePOD) ran 22 enterprise pilots with FMCG distributors and 3PLs across Mumbai, Gurgaon and Bengaluru. ACV was ₹18-24L/year, but only 4 of 22 pilots (18%) converted to paid in FY24. The leak wasn't the product: pilots ended on a champion's verbal 'it works', then stalled 90+ days in procurement and finance. Eleven win/loss calls exposed the pattern — no quantified savings, no CFO-facing business case, single-threaded on one ops champion. ACTION: We rebuilt the pilot as a 45-day instrumented proof. Week 1 captured a hard baseline (fuel cost/km, failed-delivery rate); a weekly WhatsApp scorecard went to the champion plus the ops head. At day 40 we shipped a one-page CFO ROI memo — e.g. ₹41L/year saved on a 120-truck fleet from a 7% fuel cut and lower re-delivery — and ran a LinkedIn-sourced exec roundtable where 3 existing customers shared their own numbers. Sales went multi-threaded: champion + finance + procurement, with a 90-second YouTube ROI explainer for the CFO. OUTCOME: Over two quarters pilot-to-paid rose from 18% to 47%, sales cycle fell from 94 to 61 days, and ACV expanded 22% via fleet-wide rollouts.
lesson: Enterprise pilots rarely die from a weak product — they die from a missing CFO-ready ROI trail. Instrument the pilot to capture a hard INR savings number from day one, hand it over as a one-page finance memo backed by peer proof, and multi-thread into procurement and finance before the pilot ends, not after the champion goes quiet.
